title: Former Freshworks executives-founded AI startup Dreamteam raises $53M
summary: Former Freshworks executives raise 53 million dollars for AI startup Dreamteam
detailed: Dreamteam, an AI-native CRM startup founded by former Freshworks executives, has raised $53 million in funding.
The funding round was backed by Together Fund, Accel, and Premji Invest.
Involved founders include Anand Venkatraman, Ramesh Parthasarathy, and Senthil Kanthaswamy, operating from California and Chennai.

This matters because the startup aims to disrupt traditional CRM software by deploying autonomous AI coworkers and natural-language 'Magic Apps' that reason over customer context across the entire lifecycle.
sentences: Dreamteam, an AI native customer relationship management (CRM) startup founded by former executives of Freshworks, has raised $53 million in funding from Together Fund, Accel and Premji Invest.

Founded in 2025 by Anand Venkatraman, Ramesh Parthasarathy and Senthil Kanthaswamy with headquarters in California and core engineering team in Chennai, is building a technology platform that can understand customer context and have the right AI coworkers to execute.

“The CRM was supposed to give companies a complete picture of their customers, yet the richest parts of that picture have always lived outside the CRM,” said Anand Venkatraman, Co-founder and CEO of Dreamteam.
“AI finally gives us a way to change that foundation.
Dreamteam learns from the work your team is already doing, keeps the context alive and gives every salesperson skilled AI teammates that can reason over it and move deals forward.
Your sellers and leaders can spend their time on relationships, judgement and closing deals, while Dreamteam takes care of everything required around them,” he said.
According to a statement from Dreamteam, companies across diverse industries, including AI, online media, healthcare, manufacturing, and consulting are using their technology platform.
Girish Mathrubootham, Founding partner at Together Fund, the first institutional investor in Dreamteam added: “CRM is among the biggest software categories ripe for disruption.
I've worked alongside Dreamteam's founders since day one as their vision for an AI-native CRM took shape.

Their deep CRM expertise and proven record of scaling enterprise software make them uniquely positioned to lead this reinvention.”
Looking ahead, Dreamteam aims to extend its intelligence layer beyond sales to the entire customer lifecycle, including prospecting, onboarding, customer success and upselling.
The company also offers Magic Apps, which allows business users to create custom applications and dashboards using natural language without writing code.
Shekhar Kirani, Partner at Accel said, “In the AI era, the companies that understand their customers deeply have an enormous advantage.
Today, everyone on a team sees a different version of the customer, because no central system holds all the information.
Dreamteam is building that system with AI agents.”
